description: Frozen power-model input used to render the final 100-run Fig.4. The ns-3 cumulative-energy slope supplies the temporal shape; its active range is calibrated onto the measured four-chain, 100 MHz, TDD O-RU-B DC input-power curve, while sleep remains non-zero.
source: Active power: Z. Li et al., IEEE FNWF 2025, Table II (30.5 dBm row). Simulator anchors: the pinned active-idle baseline and the 3.33 kW upper active envelope validated by the GUI full-cycle trace. Sleep: conservative 80% advanced-sleep saving from M. Q. Usman et al., IEEE CCNC 2025.
